==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Pinrong:''' Welcome to Jewel Boba!
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Pinrong:''' Welcome, dear. Fancy trying our latest dessert soup? We call it Chewy-... Gummy-Yummy SweeTEA?
::'''Pinrong:''' Quite the mouthful, isn't it? My granddaughter tells me it's all the rage with the youngsters these days. I tried it myself, and goodness, it's tasty!
:{{DIcon}} About Pinwen
::'''Pinrong:''' Pinwen... She's really my granddaughter.
::'''Pinrong:''' Thirty years ago, when I first opened this shop, I was just like her, nose buried in recipes, trying to perfect my dessert soups.
::'''Pinrong:''' My heart was warmed seeing my customers' smiles back then.
::'''Pinrong:''' Perhaps she feels the same way now, right?
:{{DIcon}} About Jewel Boba
::'''Pinrong:''' Jewel Boba is now the pride and joy of both me and my granddaughter.
::'''Pinrong:''' With her new recipes, we've been welcoming new faces every day.
::'''Pinrong:''' The first time I tasted the dessert soup my granddaughter made... It flooded me with the same joy I felt when I first made a dessert soup of my own.
::'''Pinrong:''' After all these years, those newly introduced dessert soups back then have become classics, and now we've added another batch of new ones. You know, I believe all these new creations will eventually stand the test of time and become classics themselves, don't you think?
::'''Pinrong:''' Whether it's an old classic or a new creation, as long as it brings a smile to my customers' faces, it's a success in my book.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave

{{Dialogue End}}
